title: How Did Crossrail Tunnel Past the Tube?
description:
How did Crossrail dig a new railway through ground already full of Tube tunnels?
We walk a {fact1}-metre tunnel boring machine from its spinning cutterhead to the arm that builds the tunnel's concrete rings behind it, then show how close it came to the Northern line.
Sources: Arup (Nov 2026).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
